# Exacli

> A CLI tool for the Exa AI search API. Search the web semantically, extract content from URLs, get AI-powered answers with citations, and run deep multi-step research from your terminal.

## Overview

Exacli is a command-line interface for the Exa AI search API. Written in Go with zero runtime dependencies. It provides commands for semantic web search, content extraction, AI-powered Q&A, and deep research via `search --type deep`. Outputs formatted markdown by default with JSON and TOON format support for scripting.

## Installation

```bash
# Build from source (requires Go 1.21+ and Task)
git clone https://github.com/wesbragagt/exacli.git
cd exacli
go mod download
task build
sudo cp build/exacli /usr/local/bin/
```

## Configuration

```bash
# Store API key in OS keychain
exacli login

# Or set as environment variable
export EXA_API_KEY="your-api-key-here"

# Or pass per command
exacli search "query" --api-key "your-key"
```

API key resolution order: `--api-key` flag → `EXA_API_KEY` env var → OS keychain

Get your API key at: https://dashboard.exa.ai/api-keys

## Quick Start

```bash
# Search the web
exacli search "latest AI developments"

# Search with content extraction
exacli search "machine learning papers" --text --num-results 5

# Get AI-powered answers
exacli answer "What is quantum computing?"

# Find similar pages
exacli similar "https://example.com/article"

# Run deep multi-step research with synthesis
exacli search "Latest SpaceX valuation" --type deep --system-prompt "Summarize the findings"
```

## Core Commands

### New capabilities in v3

- Select `--type lite` for low-cost cached-content search; the previous CLI rejected Lite locally.
- Request cross-result Dynamic Highlights with `--dynamic-highlights`; the previous CLI had no explicit dynamic option or opt-in header.
- Retrieve search text, highlights, and summaries using the existing flags with corrected nested content requests; the previous CLI sent extraction flags at the wrong level, where the API could ignore them.
- Read complete structured entities returned by Exa in JSON and markdown, or their non-null leaves in TOON; the previous CLI discarded entities during decoding. Place addresses, hours, and ratings are examples, not guaranteed query results.

The default search mode and existing commands are unchanged. Expanded Exa index coverage is server-side, not a new CLI command or `/v3` endpoint. See the README's "What v3 adds" section for runnable examples and Lite restrictions.

### Search
Search the web using semantic search.

```bash
exacli search "query" [options]
```

**Options:**
- `--num-results <n>`: Number of results (default: 10)
- `--type <auto|neural|keyword|hybrid|fast|instant|lite|deep|deep-lite|deep-reasoning>`: Search type; Lite uses cached content at low cost; fast/instant are legacy
- `--text`: Include full text content
- `--highlights`: Include relevant highlights
- `--dynamic-highlights`: Use cross-result Dynamic Highlights (implies `--highlights`, including when `--highlights=false`)
- `--summary`: Include AI-generated summary
- `--category <category>`: Filter by category
- `--include-domains <list>`: Comma-separated domains to include
- `--exclude-domains <list>`: Comma-separated domains to exclude
- `--start-date <date>`: Start date (ISO format)
- `--end-date <date>`: End date (ISO format)
- `--autoprompt`: Use autoprompt to enhance query
- `--output-schema <json|path>`: JSON schema for structured synthesis output (deep modes)
- `--system-prompt <text>`: System prompt guiding synthesis output (deep modes)

**Categories:** company, research paper, news, pdf, tweet, personal site, financial report, people

Use `--type deep`, `deep-lite`, or `deep-reasoning` for multi-step research with synthesis. The synthesized answer is returned in `output.content` on the response.

Lite rejects enabled `--summary` and `--autoprompt`, and nonempty `--output-schema` and `--system-prompt`. Explicitly false booleans are allowed. The default search mode and existing type values are unchanged.

Dynamic Highlights sends the required beta header only when explicitly requested. Structured entities returned by Exa remain complete in JSON `results[].entities` and the default markdown Entities JSON block. TOON includes non-null entity leaves under `results.<i>.entities.<j>`.

### Contents
Retrieve contents from specific URLs.

```bash
exacli contents <url...> [options]
```

**Options:**
- `--text`: Include full text
- `--highlights`: Include highlights
- `--summary`: Include summary
- `--max-age-hours <n>`: Maximum age of cached content

### Similar
Find pages similar to a given URL.

```bash
exacli similar <url> [options]
```

**Options:**
- `--num-results <n>`: Number of results
- `--exclude-source-domain`: Exclude same domain
- `--text`, `--highlights`, `--summary`: Content options
- `--category <category>`: Filter by category

### Answer
Get AI-powered answers with citations.

```bash
exacli answer "query" [options]
```

**Options:**
- `--text`: Include source text in citations
- `--model <exa|exa-pro>`: Model to use (default: exa)
- `--stream`: Stream response in real-time
- `--system-prompt <text>`: Custom system prompt

### Auth
```bash
exacli login   # Store API key in OS keychain
exacli logout  # Remove API key from OS keychain
```

## Global Options

- `--api-key <key>`: Exa API key
- `--json`: Output raw JSON instead of markdown
- `--toon`: Output compact TOON format
- `-h, --help`: Show help

## Examples

### Semantic Search
```bash
exacli search "hottest AI startups 2024"
exacli search "transformer architecture" --type deep --text --highlights
exacli search "AI acquisitions" --category news --start-date 2024-01-01
exacli search "AI research papers" --include-domains "arxiv.org,openai.com"
exacli search "SpaceX valuation and funding history" --type deep-reasoning --system-prompt "Summarize the findings"
```

### Content Extraction
```bash
exacli contents "https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.15004" --text
exacli contents "https://example.com/1" "https://example.com/2" --highlights --summary
```

### AI Q&A
```bash
exacli answer "What is neural machine translation?"
exacli answer "Explain large language models" --stream
exacli answer "Explain recursion" --system-prompt "Explain like I'm 5"
```

## Development

```bash
go mod download  # Download dependencies
task build       # Build binary to build/exacli
task lint        # go vet ./...
task test        # Run tests
task check       # Lint + tests
task ci          # Full CI pipeline
task compile     # Optimized binary -> dist/exacli
```
